2. This is an application seeking to quash the charge sheet bearing Sessions Case No.32/2024
arising out of first information report bearing Crime No.246/2023 registered with Sindewahi Police
Station, District Chandrapur for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 of the Indian
Penal Code and Sections 26[i], 26[2][i], 26[2][iv], 27[3][e], 30[2][a] of the Food Safety Standards
Act, 2006.

Rgd.
Smt. Sakshi W/O Ravi Khatwani vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr. P. S.O., P. ... on 23 April, 2024
Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable on 12.06.2024. Learned A.P.P. waives notice for the non-applicant.
4. In the meantime the trial Court shall not insist for presence of the applicant except on the date of framing charge on condition that the applicant shall not challenge his identity.
This order will remain in force till passing of further order in the matter.
